title: validate_session_urls uses string prefix instead of url::Url::scheme()
description: blob.rs expand_url_template and client.rs validate_session_urls check HTTPS scheme with url.starts_with("https://") (case-sensitive string match) instead of parsing the URL and calling .scheme(). RFC 3986 §3.1 specifies schemes are case-insensitive, so HTTPS:// or Https:// are valid but would be rejected. The url crate (already a dep) normalizes schemes to lowercase, so Url::parse(s)?.scheme() == "https" is the correct check.
